note: Run by the Wakamow Valley Authority on the Moose Jaw River at 300 River Drive, a short walk from downtown Moose Jaw; playground and canoe/kayak rental across the road at Kiwanis River Park. The operator asks RVs and trucks over 5 tonnes or 14 ft high to use the alternate route. Several sites have tight turns or low branches. --Claude
summary: Keep. Wakamow Valley Authority (local) campground on Let's Camp: 54 sites (42 RV with 30 A, water, 36 with sewer; 12 tent), $45-55 for an RV, May-October. Riverfront kept on the west-row sites over open grass. Fees base 39 -> 45 (the $39 electric-only sites are tent/small-trailer), hookups/sites/booking filled, note trimmed.
flags: WATERFRONT: 'riverfront' kept. The west row (sites 30-45, Let's Camp map ids site31-site42) backs onto the Moose Jaw River 15-25 m from the water; the north end (sites 30, 32, 34, about 50.3836,-105.5221) has open grass to the bank and site 30's own Let's Camp photo shows the water behind the pad. Site 71 at the south end of the river side also shows the river over open grass in its photo. The middle of the row (about sites 38-42) sits behind a band of bank trees. All sites sell by the night (no seasonal rate). River measured 30-40 m wide on Esri z18 here - at the creekside threshold, so a reviewer could argue 'creekside'.
ACCESS: operator: '**Please use alternate route if RV and truck is over 5 tons & more than 14 feet in height.**' - an alternate route exists; not a drop.
PIN: stored 50.38361,-105.52125 is on River Drive at the campground's east entrance (Let's Camp point 50.38393,-105.52172, 50 m away); loops lie within ~150 m. No move.
WEBSITE: both stored links live and this campground.

FEES: stored nightly_low 39 was the electric-only rate, which Let's Camp sells only on tent sites ('small trailer (of less than 18 feet) or a tent'); the cheapest real RV night is $45 (30 A + water, pull-through 46-51).
SEASON: no exact dates posted - kept May 1 - Oct 31 as the operator's 'May to October'.
NOTE: dropped site count, amenity list, season and booking (fields show them); 'renovated showers' not on the current page - removed; added the operator's weight/height route warning.
